title: CELM-Cardio: code and results for heterogeneous CNN ensemble cardiomegaly classification with leakage-controlled evaluation and external validation
description: Code, patient-level split manifest, experiment configuration, per-image predictions (NIH ChestX-ray14 validation/meta/test and CheXpert cohorts A/B), metrics, statistical tests, automated CTR measurements, training logs, XGBoost meta-learners and figures for the article submitted to the International Journal of Intelligent Engineering and Systems (Paper ID 20266157). Chest radiographs are not redistributed.
